short_scenes.say: My phone charges with no wire?!
short_scenes.narration: Volt puts his phone on a pad, and it charges with no cable. How?
The pad's coil makes a changing magnetic field. The shared flux passes through a coil in the phone and induces a voltage.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: A changing current in one coil makes a changing magnetic field. When that field passes through a second coil, it creates a voltage there, with no wire between them.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: The same principle runs every transformer.

short_scenes.name: Volt
